title: Witch on Stormy Seas
description: A pink-haired witch in a black corset dress and pointed hat stands barefoot on the bow of a wooden boat during a fierce storm. She holds a glowing jack-o'-lantern staff while casting swirling blue and purple magical energy, surrounded by floating carved pumpkins, lightning, and turbulent green lily pad-filled waters with a broken ship in the background.
prompt: A beautiful pink-haired witch wearing a black pointed hat, white corset top, and long black dress with high slit and orange stockings stands barefoot on the prow of a wooden boat in a stormy sea filled with green lily pads. She holds a tall staff topped with a glowing carved jack-o-lantern, casting swirling blue and purple magic. Lightning strikes in the dark cloudy sky, several other floating jack-o-lanterns surround her, broken ship masts in the background, dramatic fantasy scene
